note: New machine-readable identifiers for documented design principles, not existing CSS variable names. Values transcribed from DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; semantic identity from UI_INSPECTOR_CONTRACT.md.

keys.rule: Compact, calm, information-rich UI. Avoid decorative cards, heavy shadows and gratuitous padding.
Primary icon rail, contextual sidebar, main content, assistant sidebar. Shift the whole canvas; do not overlay navigation. Context width 168–256px.
Base 13px; metadata 11px. Use explicit hierarchy and concise labels.
4px spacing scale; internal groups 8/12/16/20px. Radius 6px, overlay radius 9px. Low surface elevation; stronger overlays only.
Control height 30/34/38px for compact/standard/comfortable; row baseline 34/39/45px.
16px visual checkbox/radio independent of 44px touch rows. Keep controls proportionate and focus visible.
Container queries; full table to structured records at narrow widths. No horizontal scrolling for DataTable; preserve fields, stable IDs and filter/selection state.
Identity header, metadata, tabs, relationships, activity, attachments, edit action; back preserves collection state.
Custom confirmation, prompt, dialog, toast, tooltip and context menu. Trap/restore focus; dismissal never approves; mobile contextual sheet/fullscreen form.
CMS/list/detail owns document lifecycle; fullscreen editor owns edit session. Layers, canvas, inspector, responsive preview, undo/redo. Draft is distinct from published snapshot.
Separate public header/nav/footer and account layout; render published snapshots. Isolate authored content theme from editor theme.
Single registered action; gather parameters, exact proposal, explicit confirmation, edit/cancel/expiry/error, typed result. UI confirmation is not authorization. No real writes in mockup.
Avatar Chathead with preview and unread indicator. Mobile launcher dock must not cover controls; suppress preview bubble on mobile; hide in fullscreen authoring.
Use semantic light/dark tokens; avoid hard-coded legacy colors. State is not communicated through color alone. Respect reduced motion.
Use explicit data-ui-component and unique data-ui-id per route; IDs independent of translated label, breakpoint and CSS. DOM-derived hashes are fallback, not durable IDs.
Check actual browser at 1920/1440/1280/1024/768/430/390/320; inspect screenshots and interactions, not just syntax or overflow. Owner visual approval required.
Use Pointer Events as the only gesture source. One shared engine handles mouse, touch and pen with pointer capture and cleanup; no module-specific touch recognition.
Define tap slop, double-tap window, long-press delay, axis lock, swipe velocity and pinch scale once. Emit visible state, pointer type and component identity.
Sortable uses a handle, ghost and placeholder with same-group drop zones, cross-container and nested moves, keyboard movement, undo and real mockup state updates.
pointercancel, lostpointercapture and Escape restore prior state, release capture and suppress only the click that follows the gesture.
Edge drag auto-scrolls the nearest scroll container, yields to nested scrolling and stops on capture loss or reduced motion.
Bottom sheets are draggable with snap states; panels resize with live size, ARIA and 44–48 px touch targets inside safe areas.
Announce gesture, pointer type and component identity in a persistent live region; never rely on hover or color alone.
Claim native touch only where the browser emits it. Chromium CDP touch, WebKit/Firefox pointer fallback and physical-device Pending Owner Review are separate evidence states.
